name: Button
summary: An action the person takes on this page: save, send, open, delete. The one control that renders a native button.
useWhen: An action that changes data or starts a task on this page
The main action of a form, a dialog or a card, as tone accent with emphasis solid
A secondary or quiet action next to the main one, as soft, outline or ghost
A link that must look like an action, through asChild
avoidWhen: A control with only an icon and no visible label
A choice that stays on or off
More than one solid accent button in the same view

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px in the default density.

tone.description: The color family. accent is the primary action color of the active style.

emphasis.description: soft is the standard button of Studio and Desk (the source secondary). tone accent with emphasis solid is the primary action.

shape.description: default takes radius.control (Desk draws it as a pill), pill is fully round, square takes radius.sm.

loading.description: Shows the spinner, sets aria-busy and data-loading, keeps the width and focus, blocks activation.

disabled.description: Sets aria-disabled and data-disabled. Stays focusable so a Tooltip can say why. The native disabled attribute is never set.

iconStart.description: A system icon name or an icon element, before the label.

iconEnd.description: A system icon name or an icon element, after the label.

fullWidth.description: Fills the width of its container. Sets data-full-width.

asChild.description: Renders the single child element, for example a link, as the button.

type.description: Native type, so a button never submits a form by accident. Ignored with asChild.

a11y.role: button (native button element), or the role of the asChild element
a11y.focus: In the tab order in every state, disabled and loading included. A 2px ring on keyboard focus; the solid accent button gets two rings, inner and outer.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the next control

a11y.announce: The label is the accessible name. Loading sets aria-busy; for a long wait, say the busy verb in a live region (Toast or a status line).
notes: Disabled and loading use aria-disabled, not the native disabled attribute, so focus never drops to the page when an action starts.
While disabled or loading, a click does not submit a form or follow an asChild link, and onClick, onPointerDown and onKeyDown do not run.
Icons inside the button are hidden from assistive tech. The label names the button.
No native title attribute. A hint comes from Tooltip.

en.label: A verb plus a noun in sentence case: Save changes, Delete project. Never OK, Continue, Confirm or Yes.
en.busy: Keep the label while loading. Say the verb in progress (Saving changes) in a live region, not on the button.
en.danger: Name what goes: Delete project, not Delete.

ar.label: Noun form labels, no diacritics: حفظ التغييرات، حذف المشروع. Never the imperative.

angular.note: Host bindings set the same data attributes; Button.css is used as is.

native.note: 44pt on iOS, 48dp on Android. No roll label.

styles.studio: Bordered and filled overlay pills. The primary action is the neutral fill from color.primary (overlay 20 with the control border). Hover and press step the overlay at once.
styles.desk: Pill shaped at every size. The primary action is yellow #ffd84d with ink text and a doubled focus ring. The label rolls up on hover and keyboard focus, a copy rolling in from below (recipes/Button.css), off under reduced motion.
styles.neutral: Planned: filled primary, outline secondary, 36 to 40px.
styles.liquid: Planned: capsule buttons with a press scale.

mistakes.wrong: Two solid accent buttons side by side
mistakes.right: One solid accent button for the main action, soft or ghost for the rest

mistakes.wrong: A button labelled OK or Continue
mistakes.right: A verb plus a noun that names the result: Save changes

mistakes.wrong: Swapping the label to Saving while loading
mistakes.right: loading on the button and the busy verb in a live region; the width holds

mistakes.wrong: A disabled button with no reason
mistakes.right: Leave it out, or keep it focusable and explain with a Tooltip

mistakes.wrong: An anchor styled with button classes
mistakes.right: Button with asChild around the anchor

mistakes.wrong: A Button with an icon and no visible text
